run-down-traveler-s-rest.title: Run-Down Traveler's Rest
walk: The Run-Down Traveler's Rest is a dilapidated cabin that can be located north of the Three-Path Cross Site of Grace See Shadow of the Erdtree Map and near the Ellac Greatbridge. There are no enemies around the location and there are no NPCs or merchants. However, you can find a body inside the cabin and you can loot it to obtain Greater Potentate's Cookbook (2) and 2x Furnace Visage.
links: See Shadow of the Erdtree Map

abandoned-ailing-village.title: Abandoned Ailing Village
walk: The Abandoned Ailing Village is a location that has been inhabited by Man-Fly enemies. The village can be found northwest of the Ellac Greatbridge in the Gravesite Plain region See Shadow of the Erdtree Map. From the entrance of the village, investigate the east section towards the cliffside where you'll spot a statue that has an item, kill the Man-Fly enemies that are around the statue, and then pick up the item to acquire x1 Revered Spirit Ash.

Return to the entrance of the village to find the Greatbridge, North Site of Grace nearby See Shadow of the Erdtree Map. As mentioned, the village is now inhabited by Man-Fly enemies, so tread carefully and avoid aggravating them in a group, since you can potentially die from being outnumbered. To identify which is the entrance of the village, it's where you'll see a Spirit NPC. If you head to the east past the NPC at night, you will find an illuminated gravesite where you can pick up a Larval Tear.

From the entrance, check the west section of the village to find a house that you can enter. Inside, you can find a body that holds x1 Broken Rune. Go to the center of the village and head up the hill where you'll find some scaffolding. If you walk a bit to the east, towards the edge of a cliff, you can spot a glowing skull that has x1 Golden Rune (1), and there's also a body near it that you can loot to acquire x1 Human Bone Shard. Next, walk up to the scaffolding to find another corpse hanging by the edge. Loot it to obtain the Ailment Talisman See Shadow of the Erdtree Map.

Now ride your mount and head to the northwest corner of the village where you'll spot a single house. Enter through the doorway, kill the Man-Fly, and loot the corpse to obtain Greater Potentate's Cookbook (10), See Shadow of the Erdtree Map.
links: See Shadow of the Erdtree Map

belurat-gaol.title: Belurat Gaol
walk: Belurat Gaol Walkthrough Video

The Belurat Gaol is a location situated under the Belurat Tower Settlement, to find the entrance of the prison area, head west from the Abandoned Ailing Village or the Greatbridge, North Site of Grace. You'll easily identify when you're near the entrance when you arrive at the area that is surrounded with water and prison cages. As you enter the depths of the prison, you will find the Belurat Gaol Site of Grace and a Summoning Pool on the right side of the Site of Grace.

This area has enemies such as Shadow Undead enemies, large and small variations of the Living Jar, and Jar Innards. This area is also a good place to farm or find Frozen Maggots The objective is to reach the bottom-most section of the gaol where a mini-boss is waiting.

church-of-benediction.title: Church of Benediction
walk: The Church of Benediction is a small location that can be found south of the Gravesite Plain region See Shadow of the Erdtree Map. There are no hostile characters and NPCs found in the Church of Benediction, however, there is some loot you can find inside and near the church. Head inside the church and investigate the statue of Marika to find the Blessed Blue Dew Talisman. And if you check the edge of a cliff, near its doorway, you'll spot a corpse hanging. Loot the body to find the Oathseeker Knight Set which contains the following pieces:
Oathseeker Knight Greaves
Oathseeker Knight Gauntlets
Oathseeker Knight Armor
Oathseeker Knight Helm
including the Pata weapon.
There is also a glowing skull on the ground near the doorway of the church, breaking it will drop a Golden Rune (1).

church-of-the-crusade.title: Church of the Crusade
walk: You can reach this area by going west after the army encampment in front of the Shadow Keep - Main Gate in Scadu Altus. Go inside and walk down the aisle here and you will be invaded by the Fire Knight Queelign. If this is your 2nd encounter with Queelign, you will receive the Ash of War: Flame Skewer and a Prayer Room Key upon defeating him.
You will encounter the same NPC invader in the following areas:
Belurat Tower Settlement
Shadow Keep

Going back to the Church of the Crusade, walk over to the altar behind the burning pot, and make sure to pick up the x2 Scadutree Fragment in front of the tall statue of Marika. On your way out, look to your right and pick up Rune Arc next to the toppled pillars.

Outside the church, head northeast and go to the very edge. You will find an injured Forager Brood here who is unable to move. To help it, drop a Warming Stone next to it then wait for it to get up. Rest at a nearby Site of Grace, come back to the location to receive Forager Brood Cookbook (4) and x3 Shadow Sunflower from it.

fog-rift-catacombs.title: Fog Rift Catacombs
walk: ER Shadow of the Erdtree Fog Rift Catacombs Walkthrough Video Guide
ER Shadow of the Erdtree Death Knight Boss Guide

Fog Rift Catacombs is located west of the Church of Crusade and north of Fog Rift Fort. The entrance of the catacombs leads to an elevator that goes down. You'll immediately find the Fog Rift Catacombs Site of Grace and a tunnel path straight ahead. Head through the tunnel entrance and prepare yourself for an Imp that will ambush you. At the upper right side of the room is a corpse holding a Grave Glovewort [1].

After retrieving that item, turn left through another tunnel entrance which leads to a large open room. Upon exiting the tunnel, immediately turn left towards a safe spot because half of the room is rigged with a spike trap that descends from above. Wait for it to come down, and once it goes up, immediately run to the other side where a Lion Head Goblin is waiting for you. Take out the Goblin and head straight to the next tunnel entrance leading to a large hallway. Turn right and head straight towards the stairs going down, but before heading down, pick up the Yellow Fulgurbloom to your left.

After collecting the plant, head down the stairs and turn right into another tunnel in the catacombs. You'll see a corpse that gives you the Ancient Dragon Knight's Cookbook [1] along with a Yellow Fulgurbloom plant. Head back to where you turned right earlier, and this time, turn left down another set of stairs. This will lead you to what looks like a dead-end ledge, but wait a few seconds for the spike trap from earlier to fall down. Once it falls, hop on top of it, and it will lead you to a secret platform with a Lion Head Goblin, a corpse that gives you x3 Knot Resin, and a Yellow Fulgurbloom plant.

After looting the platform, hop on the spike trap again, but don't go back yet. Instead, wait for the spike trap to take you back up again, and this time, look for a tunnel entrance to the left that you can drop onto. Once you enter the tunnel and the room, turn left again until you cross a bridge and a set of stairs going up. Here, you'll encounter Messmer Soldiers guarding a room. Head inside the room after defeating the Messmer Soldiers, and you'll face a Black Knight. Defeat the Black Knight, then pick up the Great Ghost Glovewort. Go outside the room, then turn left to jump on top of a spiked platform, then go through a hallway. Follow the pathway and you will find the Black Knight Commander Andreas summon at the end.

Make your way back to where you first saw the spike area from a ledge. Instead of hopping back on, wait for it to drop and go up. Then immediately drop down and enter the tunnel entrance behind you. The small room here contains a Yellow Fulgurbloom. Inside the room on the left side is a ladder going up. Head up the ladder and follow the tunnel path with three Yellow Fulgurblooms.

After looting the plants, walk to the right and drop down to the area from earlier where you saw the spike trap. Drop down again and stand at the tunnel entrance behind you from earlier. Wait for the spike trap to drop, then immediately run to the other side where a set of stairs goes down. Here, you'll find a corpse that gives you x2 Dragonbolt Grease.

Head down the stairs to find another elevator that goes further down. Upon reaching the ground, head straight towards a room with two Lion Head Goblins and loot the corpse and plant under the stairs to get x4 Rada Fruit and a Yellow Fulgurbloom. From under the stairs, head straight towards the tunnel entrance on the other side of the room, but loot two more Yellow Fulgurblooms to the left.

Inside the small room, clear out the two enemies and loot the corpse on the upper right for a Grave Glovewort [2]. After looting the corpse, head out of the room and turn right towards another tunnel entrance with stairs going further down. This leads to an open hallway with spike traps covering half of the hallway. Just as before, run to the left towards a safe space, kill the imp waiting for you there, and wait for the spike trap to drop. Once it drops, hug the wall and run straight until you see a hole to the left where you can drop down into what appears to be a sewage area. Once you land in the sewage, head straight for the tunnel entrance ahead and loot the corpse for a Ghost Glovewort [4].

On the left side of the first sewage room is an entrance to another room. Enter and turn left towards another room containing five Yellow Fulgurblooms and a corpse that drops an Electrocharge. Exit that room, turn left towards a ladder going up. Climb the ladder and drop down from the platform to find yourself near the hallway spike trap from earlier. Wait for the spike trap to drop, and once it does, run towards the other end of the hallway. Get to the second safe spot to the left, past the hole you dropped into earlier, and loot the corpse there to get a Glass Shard. Wait for the spike trap to drop again, then run towards the stairs leading to a casket above that you can loot for a Shadow Realm Rune [3].

Once you're done looting, stay on the ledge of the platform you're standing on in front. Wait for the spike trap to drop, and you'll see a small square space on the side of the spike trap that you can hop onto. Hop onto the square platform and let the spike trap raise you to a secret platform above with a chest containing the Ash of War: Blinkbolt. After looting, hop on top of the spike trap again and run to the other side until you see a small platform to the right to drop onto. You'll see an altar that changes the Stone-Sheathed Sword to the Sword of Darkness.

To the left is a ladder going down. This ladder leads to a secret room with a corpse that gives you a Ghost Glovewort [5]. Loot it, then immediately look to the left to see another hole to drop into. This hole will drop you back to a safe spot from the hallway spike trap from earlier. Wait for the spike trap to drop, and once it does, run to the other side this time instead of the platform from earlier. Be careful in the safe area here as it connects to another spike trap area.

Wait for the spike trap on the other side to drop, then cross towards a tunnel entrance. Loot the corpse in the middle first for a Broken Rune. Head through the tunnel entrance to find another elevator that goes down. Drop here and head straight until you reach the yellow mist that leads to the Death Knight boss. For a comprehensive boss guide on the Death Knight, you may go to this page.
notes: There are no illusory walls in this dungeon.

suppressing-pillar.title: Suppressing Pillar
walk: The Suppressing Pillar is a tall structure where players can find a single item at the top. It can be found in the east part of the Gravesite Plain region See Shadow of the Erdtree Map. Upon arriving, simply enter the pillar to find a lift, ride it to the top, and you'll spot a treasure chest that contains x1 Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone. There's nothing much else to do here but you can also find a headstone to read a message that says:
"The very center of the Lands Between.
All manners of Death wash up here, only to be suppressed."
On clear weather, the top of the Suppressing Pillar provides the best preview of all of the regions of the Realm of Shadow.

fog-rift-fort.title: Fog Rift Fort
walk: ER Shadow of the Erdtree Fog Rift Fort Video Walkthrough

Fog Rift Fort can be accessed from the Scadu Altus West Grace See Elden Ring Map by dropping down the rocky platforms and landing on one of the fort's towers. Drop down from the tower by jumping or using the ladder, and you'll encounter Messmer Soldiers on top of the fort's walls. Once you take them out, look to your left and you'll see a corpse that you can loot, which has x10 Fire Arrow.

Afterward, follow the path until you reach the second wall tower of the fort. You can find a corpse containing x8 Redflesh Mushroom by the barrels in this room. Head out, and you'll encounter a wooden bridge to your right guarded by six Messmer Soldiers. The wooden bridge leads to a rocky platform with another corpse that you can loot for the Greater Potentate's Cookbook (3).

After looting the corpse on the rocky platform, head back to the wall of the fort by crossing the bridge again and continuing on the path. Turn left to another bridge that leads to a small stone house on the other side, where you'll encounter a boss. For a complete guide on how to beat the boss, check out Black Knight Garrew. This boss drops the Black Steel Greatshield. After slaying the boss, head inside the stone house he emerged from and open the chest, which contains eight Smithing Stone [7].

Next, head towards the small opening between the cliff and the left side of the stone house. Drop down on a ledge. Follow the stairs, and climb two sets of ladders to reach the top of a tower with a treasure chest containing the Arrow's Soaring Sting Talisman. Drop back down the ladder and jump on the cliff in front of it, then jump down to return to where the boss was. Now, head to the right of the stone house and access a small part of the wall path. You'll encounter two more Messmer Soldiers and find another corpse holding x1 Somber Smithing Stone [2]. Once you've cleared out the walls of the fort, head back to the bridge that connected the wall path and the boss area, then turn left to a wooden platform with a ladder going down. This will lead you to the grounds of the fort where more Messmer Soldiers await you. The first three soldiers you'll encounter are stationed to the left of the ladder near a spike barricade. After taking them out, you'll find a corpse in the middle of the barricade that holds the Messmerfire Grease.

After looting the corpse, be careful when combatting the rest of the soldiers on the ground. Luckily, they are spread out and in the open, so you can take them out one by one using a ranged weapon. These soldiers are also stationed next to fire turrets. There are two fire turrets in front, two on the opposite side of where you are, and one on the right.
Once you've cleared out the ground, head to the opposite side of the ground where you'll find some tents. One of these tents contains a chest with the Serpent Flail.

ruined-forge-lava-intake.title: Ruined Forge Lava Intake
walk: Ruined Forge Lava Intake Video Walkthrough

The Ruined Forge Lava Intake location can be found southeast past the Ellac Greatbridge See Shadow of the Erdtree Map. By the entrance is where you'll find the Ruined Lava Forge Intake Site of Grace. Head down the stairs, turn right, and then climb down the ladder (or jump down). Go forward and turn left into a dead-end room where you'll encounter a Golem Smith enemy. Kill the enemy and then check the floor of this room to find items such as x1 Gas Stone, x1 Smithing Stone [4], and x1 Smithing Stone [1]. There is also a corpse in this room, sitting against the wall from where the Golem was standing. You can loot the body to obtain x4 Smithing Stone [5]. Proceed to the opposite side where you'll encounter a Lava Slime.

Continue going straight until you enter another room where you'll spot a body lying on the ground, near the railings. Loot the body to find x7 Smithing Stone [2] and also x1 Smithing Stone [1], x1 Smithing Stone [3] on the floor, near the corpse. Proceed to the next section on the left side of the body, then walk to the end, and climb down the ladder. On this floor, you'll encounter more enemies, some smithing stones, and x2 Gas Stone that you can pick up. From the ladder, if you look to your right, you'll see some shabby stairs. If you check below, you'll find a corpse that can be looted to obtain x1 Somber Smithing Stone [2].

Head up the stairs and you'll find more smithing stones that you can pick up on the ground, including another body that you can loot to acquire Greater Potentate's Cookbook (13). Around the cookbook item, you can also pick up x1 Smithing Stone [3] on the ground. If you look behind, you'll find a broken pillar that you can use to walk on. Reach the other side and walk around the narrow pathway where you should find x3 Smithing Stone [7] that you can pick up from the floor.
Turn around and jump across to reach the narrow sides of the platform. You should spot another corpse sitting by the edge of the narrow sides. Loot it to acquire x2 Smithing Stone [4].

Go back to the narrow platform and approach the broken pillar that you used to cross, you should find a path that leads to a ladder that you can climb down. On this section, you'll find more smithing stones you can loot, x1 Glass Shard from a body, and a lever that you can pull. Pulling the lever will bring down a large pillar that you can use to cross and reach an upper section of the forge. Next, climb back up the ladder to go back to the previous room, jump down, and proceed west towards a doorway. But before you go through that doorway, look to the left and you'll find another path leading to a dead end. You should find another Golem sitting in front of a corpse that can be looted. This body holds x1 Somber Smithing Stone [6]. Retrace your steps and head to the doorway, towards the next section.

As you enter the next section, you'll spot another body ahead, next to another Golem, and on the right, is another ladder you can climb down. Before climbing down the ladder, kill the Golem enemy and pillage the body nearby to acquire the Smithscript Dagger and a Smithing Stone [4] near it.

Now jump onto the large pipe and walk to the end. Be wary of the Lava Slime that will drop from the ceiling when you're about midway to the top. Look to your right and you'll find a small room with an altar inside. Jump across and interact with the altar to receive x1 Anvil Hammer and x1 Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone. You can fast travel to the entrance by interacting with the white teleporter that appears next to the altar on the right.
links: See Shadow of the Erdtree Map

dragon-s-pit.title: Dragon's Pit
walk: Dragon's Pit is found by following the path southwest nearby Igon, from the Pillar Path Waypoint Site of Grace. Its entrance is a tight cave marked by torches outside. Once you enter the cave, you will eventually encounter the Dragon's Pit Site of Grace. Continuing through the cave, you will enter a more spacious part that resembles a ritual room. There are skeleton enemies here. Afterward, loot the corpse at the back of the ritual area inside a mini cave to obtain a Smithing Stone [1].

Exit the mini cave and turn left, following another tight path until you reach a cliff with a ledge path to the left. Follow the ledge and drop onto the platform below where a skeleton enemy is waiting. After defeating the enemy, go to the altar on the left and loot the corpse to find the Shadow Realm Rune [2].

Turn left from the altar and navigate another tight part of the cave until you enter a room with multiple skeleton enemies and a staircase leading up. Clear the area, then head up the staircase to find a corpse on the left holding Knot Resin. On the right, you will encounter a Lesser Magma Wyrm. After slaying the dragon, loot the corpse near a hole to obtain a Smithing Stone [5].

Return to the staircase and head downstairs until you see another tight part of the cave. After passing through, you will enter a larger section with small structures and torches. Proceed straight ahead and drop down the cliff. Though it’s a long fall, it won't kill you. Upon landing, you will immediately see a yellow mist indicating a boss ahead. Before proceeding through the mist, look back to find a corpse holding a Smithing Stone [4]. The boss in this area is the Ancient Dragon-Man. For a detailed guide on how to defeat this boss, refer to the Ancient Dragon-Man page. This boss drops the Dragon-Hunter's Great Katana.

After defeating the Ancient Dragon-Man, look to the other side where you'll find a large double door. Loot the boss and proceed through this door to reach the Dragon's Pit Terminus Site of Grace, which is also the path leading to the Jagged Peak Region where all the dragons reside.
links: Pillar Path Waypoint Site of Grace

temple-town-ruins.title: Temple Town Ruins
walk: The Temple Town Ruins is located near the Gravesite Plain, southeast of the Rauh Ancient Ruins, West Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map. Start at Moorth Ruins and head north. Then go east past a pool of water and through a tunnel. The tunnel has a beheaded Snake of Marika at its entrance. You'll come out in a swamp. Keep going northwest to reach Rauh Base and the Ancient Ruins Base Site of Grace. From there, head southwest through a woody crevasse. You'll arrive at the remains of a village with shadows everywhere. The Temple Town Ruins Site of Grace is on the northwest edge of the old town.

After activating the Temple Town Ruins Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map, follow the river going east. You will be by the ruins area with Shadow Pothead enemies scattered around the ruins. Explore the ruins area, and you'll find x4 Rada Fruit on a dead body on top of a collapsed roof. You can also find x1 Revered Spirit Ash on the southern part of the ruins. Afterwards, you can head west through the archway to find the graveyard section of the ruins. You can pick up x1 Grave Glovewort [8] on a dead body. A Spiritgrave Stone can also be picked up on the western side of the graveyard, by the gravestones on the corner.

To get inside the ruins' structure, you can find a small opening on the southern part of the wall of the enclosed structure. You will encounter numerous Shadow Undead, Shadow Pothead and Rotten Strays, so be prepared to face numerous enemies. On the southeastern corner of the ruins, you can find x3 Beast Blood by a collapsed roof, along with x1 Golden Rune [1]. Continue heading north, and you can pick up a Somber Smithing Stone [3] by a wall on the west side beside a Shadow Undead.

Head up the stairs on the east side, then go south to find a Shadow Pothead. Continue heading up the stairs covered by tattered cloth. Go on the northwestern edge of the collapsed roof, then drop down carefully to get to the area under the roof. Once you have successfully dropped down, you'll be in a small room with pots and a Shadow Undead. Go past the archway, and you'll encounter another Shadow Pothead. In this area, you can loot the dead body to obtain a Scadutree Fragment. Exit the structure through where you dropped earlier, then head northwest.

Traverse through the bridge on the northwestern side, picking up x2 Furlcalling Finger Remedy along the way. You will encounter a Horned Warrior going down the stairs. After defeating the Horned Warrior, go up the stairs where it was coming down from. A structure will be at the top of the stairs containing a chest. Open the chest to find the Two-Handed Sword Talisman.

moorth-ruins.title: Moorth Ruins
walk: Return to Scadu Altus Site of Grace and read the Monk's Missive. From here, head to the path leading to the southwest to Moorth Ruins. You will find Dryleaf Dane here who you will challenge to a fight. He is standing near the Site of Grace and next to Miquella's Cross. To prompt this, use the Gesture: May the Best Win while facing him. He will drop Dryleaf Arts and Dane's Hat upon his death. Walk toward the area behind him and you will arrive at Moorth Ruins. You will be fighting phantom enemies here and this enemy type can be difficult to see at night. There are two holes in the area which will lead you through an underground path.
The first hole can be entered through the door of a collapsed building to the southeast. You will find a broken roof, where you can pick up a Shattered Stone Talisman from a corpse.

From the roof you can see the bottom of the ruins, which can be accessed through the second hole. To reach it, return to the building's entrance and walk forward a bit, you should spot an L-shaped building in the distance, which contains another underground path.

In this area you will fight two shadow dogs and find 3x Whiteflesh Mushroom and 2x String. Jumping further down and heading towards the back of the tunnel you will find a Golden Horn Tender, then towards the front of the tunnel you will jump down a ledge where you will se a chest containing Golden Arcs, guarded by 3 Mage enemies who cast Golden Arcs. You will then jump down into a balcony and to the ground. You can pick up a Shadow Sunflower from a corpse below the balcony. Then, head to the small cave opening here with a faint ghostflame. At the end of this cave, use the ladder to reach Bonny Village.

bonny-village.title: Bonny Village
walk: Use the Site of Grace after exiting the well. Look around and you will see multiple jars in the area. This area appears to be filled with them in every corner but they are not alive. You will be fighting shadow enemies here and encounter a Greater Potentate. You will find Redflesh Mushroom in the area or pick them up after defeating shadow enemies. Keep heading down the path in the village and look at the houses on the left side and pick up the Kukri under a small roof. When you see the broken bridge in front of you, turn around and look at the area to your right. You can pick up the Bonny Butchering Knife from a corpse here.

Make your way to the broken bridge and try to take out the ghost hounds here. You can also see the loot that they are guarding here. When it's safe, jump down the area and take Human Bone Shard and 2 Living Jar Shard from the corpses. Now, follow the path to the northwest until a figure comes into view. Don't worry, this area is safe. You can pick up the Revered Spirit Ash from this small altar. Now, teleport to the Bonny Village - Site of Grace and jump to the other side of the bridge. Head north past the orange trees here and you can see a corpse in the middle of the open ground. Pick up the O Mother Gesture here. After doing so, go to the bridge south of Bonny Village.

You will find spiked barricades and broken cages on either side of the path. Continue following this path and be careful of the 2 Giant Scorpions that will attack you from either side. Keep an eye out for an opening to the right side of the wall. When you see it, enter the cave to go to Bonny Gaol.
notes: Note: crossing the bridge to the east of the village and continuing north will trigger a story event (identical to the one that triggers when approaching Shadow Keep) which may lock you out of certain NPC dialogue and items if their questlines are not progressed far enough.

Based on the Bonny Village phantom dialogue (near the Whipping Hut), the Tooth Whip found east of the village, the Bonny Butchering Knife, and the multitude of jars littering the village, this place seems to have played a significant role in the Hornsent rituals which involved stuffing Shamans (Queen Marika's kin) into jars to be turned into saints, which resulted in the creation of the Jar Innards monstrosities.

There appears to be the discarded flesh of a giant snake, likely the molten skin of Eiglay the God Devouring Serpent, or possibly Messmer's Base Serpent, near the location of the O Mother Gesture. This is possibly the snake that Queen Marika is seen reaching into, in the Shadow of the Erdtree trailer. None of the lore items elaborate on its placement so the significance of it is unknown.

bonny-gaol.title: Bonny Gaol
walk: ER Shadow of the Erdtree Bonny Gaol Video Walkthrough

After entering from outside, you'll first encounter the Bonny Gaol site of grace See Shadow of the Erdtree Map and a Summoning Pool statue. Proceeding onwards, you'll find yourself at a massive icy cavern, with jars suspended by chains from the ceiling.

Take the path to the right, and a Jar Innards enemy will emerge up ahead and start attacking you. Once you're by the large metal grate where you can see a currently unreachable item, there will be multiple ways to proceed. To the right of the grate, you can enter a room where a Shadow Undead can be heard grovelling. Shadow Undead that are grovelling, kneeling, or sitting at tables don't attack you unless you attack them. Loot the body it was grovelling over for x8 Frozen Maggot, but watch out for the Jar Innards that will crawl out of an overturned jar to attack you.

After exiting the room, you'll see two hanging jars to the left, below the path you're on. Carefully jump down to the lower jar - it's actually a lift that will lower you to an area with two rooms. The closest room leads to a Shadow Undead that will run at you from behind some boxes, and x3 Frozen Maggot around the room that you can loot. Proceed to the second room, but beware the Jar Innards that will run out of the room as you approach. Entering the room, there will be another Jar Innards that will burst out of a jar to attack you, and a Hefty Cracked Pot that you can loot. Jars that Jar Innards can burst out of are always visibly cracked. Return to the ledge near the jar lift, where you can step on a stone sigil to call it back down. Ride the jar lift back up.

Proceed onwards from the original path, ignoring an open room to the right (you'll return here later), and enter a room with multiple cages. There's a Shadow Undead sitting at a table, as well as a corpse with x10 Bolt that you can loot. Be careful as you approach the corpse, as 3 Shadow Undead will lunge at you. Avoid their grab attacks, as they will latch onto you and bite you, and can drain significant amounts of your HP.

Open the door to your left, entering a room with 3 more Shadow Undead - one of them will lunge at you as you proceed onwards. Next to a lit brazier, there's a hole you can jump down which leads to a dark cave. You can pick up a Broken Rune close to where you landed. There are two ways to proceed - east and west. Head east, where you'll encounter multiple Giant Rat enemies. In the wide area with the big Giant Rat, you can enter a narrow cave to the right to take x4 Smithing Stone [2] from a corpse. Return to the path, continuing on until you reach a ladder you can climb up. At the top of the ladder, watch out for a Jar Innards that will burst out of a cracked jar. Before exiting through the hole in the wall, be sure to grab the Stalwart Horn Charm +2 talisman from a nearby corpse. Now, proceed through the hole in the wall, where you'll find a kneeling Shadow Undead and a Frozen Maggot - this is the room you ignored earlier. Exit the room.

Make your way back to the dark cave area that you jumped down to. This time, head west. As you proceed, you'll find an area where multiple Skeletal Slime enemies will drop from the ceiling. If you look around, you'll see that there are 2 paths to take from this area. Feel free to ignore the northwest path, as you'll just end up in a room with more Skeletal Slimes and just one Broken Rune that you can loot. If you take the south path, you'll encounter even more Skeletal Slimes. Just before you jump through the hole in the brick wall, if you turn around and head north, you'll find another Skeletal Slime waiting to drop from the ceiling, and an Invigorating Cured Meat on a corpse. Now, head through the hole to reach a new, lower area of the gaol, with mounds of countless dead bodies.

Follow the water, proceeding onwards until you reach a large area with light coming in from the ceiling. This area has many Living Jar enemies, both large and small. On the right (south) side of the room, there will be a Lost Ashes of War, behind one of the large stone pillars and in front of a large Living Jar soaking in a waterfall. On the left (north) side of the room, there will be a large Living Jar resting, and a corpse by a grate that you can loot a Broken Rune from. In total, there are x4 Frozen Maggot in the area. Once you're done with this area, head to the east end of the room and proceed through an opening into the next area.

There will be an Innard Meat ahead of you that you can loot, but watch out for a Jar Innards that will burst out of a cracked jar hanging above you. As you head to the north side of the room, a Jar Innards will run out from a broken jar. Kill it, and then to the west side of the room, there will be a broken jar that with a Jar Innards that crawls out as you approach it. The broken jar it crawled out of contains a Raw Meat Dumpling. In total, this room contains x3 Frozen Maggot. Heading into the next room, you'll see a Frozen Maggot, as well as a hanging cracked jar containing yet another Jar Innards. Exit the room, where you'll see the large cavern with hanging jars again.

Take the stairs to the left, where you'll see multiple Shadow Undead up ahead. Once you're at the bottom of the stairs, if you turn left, you'll find a corpse in an open cell that you can loot for a Silver Horn Tender. Towards the ledge, there is a Frozen Maggot you can pick up, and 4 Shadow Undead, of which one of them is standing up and will turn to fight you. Opposite to the ledge, there will be another open cell, this time with a Shadow Undead and x3 Frozen Maggot. Just before you enter the next section, there will be another Shadow Undead that will lunge at you. You'll find a Frozen Maggot in the same room. Proceed to a door that you can open to enter a room with 2 Shadow Undead at a table. Upon exiting the room, you'll find yourself at a ledge where a jar is hanging below you. Get on it and it will start lowering, but instead of getting off the jar, stay on it and it will automatically take you all the way up to another area. If you got off the jar by accident and are now on the bridge, there's a sigil nearby that a Shadow Undead is grovelling over, which you can step on to call the jar lift back down.

If you rode the jar lift up, you'll now be at the top level of Bonny Gaol, where you can pick up the Night Set from a corpse by a guillotine, in front of 2 Shadow Undead. Go up the stairs, but watch out for the Jar Innards waiting for you at the top. Behind it, you can find a ledge with a corpse slumped over it, which you can loot the Shield of Night from. Head back to the ledge that you jumped onto to reach this area. There will be a stationary hanging jar below that you can use to safely jump down, to once again reach the jar lift. This time, get off the jar lift at the bottom, to reach a bridge.

Head across the bridge, where you'll encounter a Shadow Undead that runs and cowers from you, and 2 Jar Innards waiting for you in cracked jars. Once you're across the bridge, you can jump down to an area to the northwest. Follow the path ahead, where you'll find x2 Frozen Maggot and one final Jar Innards waiting to ambush you from an open cell. Head down the stairs to where 2 Shadow Undead are walking around. Just before you cross the golden fog, there will be x2 Frozen Maggot nearby, one of which will be around some breakable crates by a ledge.

You will be fighting Curseblade Labirith here, a boss that wields dual blades and can turn himself invisible. You will receive the Curseblade Meera summon upon defeating this boss. You can visit this page for a strategy on how to beat him.
links: See Shadow of the Erdtree Map

ruined-forge-of-starfall-past.title: Ruined Forge of Starfall Past
walk: ER Shadow of the Erdtree Ruined Forge of Starfall Past Video Walkthrough

The Ruined Forge of Starfall is located southeast of Castle Ensis. Its entrance is a broken-down structure with a small tunnel entrance on the west side. Enter the tunnel and follow it until you reach a ladder that descends further underground. Climb down the ladder to find an abandoned shelter, where the Ruined Forge of Starfall Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map is located.

After setting up the Site of Grace, head immediately to the doorway and you'll find a Smithing Stone [6], Smithing Stone [5], and x5 Smithing Stone [3] on the ground. In the first area, you'll encounter two Misbegotten enemies. One is below the small bridge that connects to the other side of the room, and the other is on the far side of the bridge. Eliminate these enemies and pull the lever on the other side of the bridge, which will open an iron door below the bridge on the left side. Near the lever, you can pick up a Smithing Stone [2]. Before heading down to the iron door, go to the opposite side of the lever to find x1 Smithing Stone [2] and a Smithscript Spear. Drop down from the bridge to take out the Misbegotten below. There's another Smithing Stone [3] and Smithing Stone [2] opposite the iron door. Just beside the iron door on the left, you'll find another Smithing Stone [2] and Smithing Stone [3]. Enter the iron door and immediately hide in a small space to the right. You'll need to take cover here for a few seconds because a Fire Blob will shoot fire projectiles from the other side of the passage.

You can pull the lever in your hiding spot to close the iron door again. Once another projectile crosses, run toward the Fire Blob and take it out. In the next area, there are two levels and another passage to the right leading to another area. From the entrance of the iron passage, go left to grab the Smithing Stone [6] and Smithing Stone [3] on the ground. A Golem Smith is lurking behind some rubble, so be alert and take it out. To the left of the golem are x2 Smithing Stone [2].

Once you've looted the first level of the second area, go to the other passage on the right. As before, another Fire Blob will be shooting projectiles from the far side. Run to the nearest cover on the right, but be ready to fight, as another Fire Blob will be waiting to ambush you there. Take out the hiding Fire Blob and wait in cover. Left of the Fire Blob, you can find a Smithing Stone [5] and Smithing Stone [6]. There's also a Smithing Stone [3] in the cover area. Wait for a projectile to cross, then run toward the Fire Blob and take it out. Through the second passage, you'll come across a ladder going up to the right. You can find Smithing Stone [2] and Smithing Stone [5] as you traverse through the path. Before heading up, go straight a bit to a small dead-end area and prepare to fight a Golem Smith hiding on the left. This small room contains a Somber Smithing Stone [7] by a skeleton and a Smithing Stone [3].

Afterward, head up the ladder to reach the second level of this area. Follow the path to a room filled with three Fire Blobs and a Golem Smith. There's a Somber Smithing Stone [8] by a corpse on the ground, so pick it up. Head up the broken-down rubble to the left to reach the third level and enter the passage to the right. This will lead you back to the second area you encountered earlier, and you can drop to the second level. Before jumping to the second level, look to the left to see a small dead-end room with a corpse holding the Smithing Talisman. Enter this dead-end room, and a group of Fire Blobs will drop from the ceiling, which you need to take out.

There's a Golem Smith on the right side of the area near the bridge and a Fire Blob on a small platform once you drop down. Once you take out the golem, you can loot the second level of the second area. There's a Smithing Stone [8] by a sitting corpse on the small platform. Crossing the bridge to the other side, you can pick up a Smithing Stone [6] and a Gas Stone. Once you've looted the second level, pull the lever to open another iron door on the left side. Enter the iron door and follow the path to a mid-sized room with two Golem Smiths ready to ambush you—one to the right and one to the left. Once you clear the room, you can loot it to find a Smithing Stone [6] and a Smithscript Cirque by a corpse next to the sewage waterfall.

Do not drop down the sewage waterfall as it will kill you. Instead, head back to the passage that connects the second area and the room with the sewage waterfall. Pull the lever to the left to activate the iron door. Before the iron door rises to close, immediately jump above the iron door. Once it stops, go to the platform on the right to find an entrance to a small room. This room contains an altar that you can interact with to receive the Ancient Meteoric Ore Greatsword and an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
notes: The last door opened by lever, pull the lever and ride the door up.

whipping-hut.title: Whipping Hut
walk: The eastern region of Scadu Altus can be accessed through the Bonny Village. Players will find access to this area from the tunnel under Moorth Ruins connecting to the Site of Grace in Bonny Village. Teleport there and head east by crossing the bridge. You will find the Whipping Hut at the edge, and you can pick up the Tooth Whip from the corpse inside the hut. You can also interact with the ghost here just outside the hut.

rabbath-s-rise.title: Rabbath's Rise
walk: The Rabbath's Rise is located in the eastern region of Scadu Altus. You will find it along the path after exploring Bonny Village, an area where you will encounter Wolves and a Furnace Golem. Defeating the Furnace Golem here will drop Cerulean-Sapping Cracked Tear and a Furnace Visage. Continue the path ahead until you pass through Rabbath's Rise. Activate the Church of High Road - Site of Grace before continuing. Turn right to formally enter Rabbath's Rise here. This is a tower building with some of its steps destroyed. You will also see some glowing crystals on the ground floor.

Go through the door to your left and climb the spiral stairs. When you reach the study room with tall bookshelves lined on the walls, make sure to hit the wall with 2 arches. This is a secret wall hiding a stack of stones. Destroy it to reveal a nearby Spiritspring. You can't use the elevator yet, so you need to go outside the tower and look for the spiritspring.
Summon Torrent and ride up the wind to reach the top of the tower. Open the chest to get Rabbath's Cannon. On your way down, you can now use the elevator that was previously stuck.

cathedral-of-manus-metyr.title: Cathedral of Manus Metyr
walk: Starting from Rabbath's Rise, you can follow the path going south to reach the Cathedral of Manus Metyr. Start by exploring around the Cathedral, you will be able to find Greater Potentate's Cookbook (4) Map Link on a body that is surrounded by a mob. Behind the Cathedral, you will find a Remembrance Duplication Coffin Map Link. On the walkway around the Cathedral, you can find 2 Glinting Nails Map Link. Enter the Cathedral and activate the Cathedral of Manus Metyr Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map, in front of it there are gates that you can open. Open them to get through and you will find Jolan, a knight that serves Count Ymir, to the right, and on the throne is Count Ymir.
On your first encounter with Count Ymir, he will give you the Ruins Map and Hole-Laden Necklace. The necklace is a key item that will be used to sound a hanging bell at a hallowed ruin.

With the first map, you can travel to the Finger Ruins of Rhia. You can reach the Finger Ruins of Rhia by traveling southeast from the Cerulean Coast Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map. Go past the toppled pillar and stick to the wall on your left side. Continue following it as you go up the ramp, past the glowing worm creatures. You will come around and find the entrance past the shoreline and behind the dragon. Go up the ramp and you will see a small-altar-like structure at the very end. You can pick up the Grave Glovewort (9) here. On the right side, you can jump down to activate the Ruins of Rhia Site of Grace. Explore the area, and once you reach the bell, interact with it and you will be granted the Crimson Seed Talisman +1. Return to the Cathedral of Manus Metyr then speak to Count Ymir again, and he will grant you the Ruins Map (2nd) and Beloved Stardust.

With the second map, fast travel to the Shadow Keep, Back Gate Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map, facing the entrance of the structure, go left and you will find a Summoning Pool that you can activate and a room you can go into. Head into the room, on the left is a message that reads "Have mercy, For the spirited-away shamans." and straight ahead you can pick up the Scadutree Fragment at the altar. At the altar, you will need to perform the O Mother Gesture in front of the altar to trigger it to move. Go through the hidden tunnel and you will find yourself at the Hinterlands. On your way to the Finger Ruins of Dheo, you will encounter a lot of smaller enemies that could potentially kill you so you will need to be careful in this area. Once you reach the end, you can interact with the bell, and you will be granted the Cerulean Seed Talisman +1. Return to the Cathedral of Manus Metyr and speak to Count Ymir and he will give you the Ruins Map (3rd).

With the third map, make sure you fast travel somewhere else and then fast travel back to the Cathedral of Manus Metyr so Count Ymir will not be there. Make your way over to the throne you once met Count Ymir on, this time you can examine the throne. Interact with it to see it slide back and reveal a rope ladder. Take the ladder down to reach the Finger Ruins of Miyr.

Once you head down, NPC invader Swordhand of Night Anna will appear, defeat her and you will be granted the Claws of Night. You will be able to find a few Finger Mimics scattered around the area, other than that, you can find the Finger-Weaver's Cookbook (2) on a body on the lower left walkway of the path. Nearing the bell, you can interact with the Summoning Pool to activate it and then interact with the hanging bell to teleport you to the Metyr, Mother of Fingers arena.

Once you defeat Metyr, Mother of Fingers you will be granted 420,000 Runes and the Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers. You can then fast-travel back to the Cathedral of Manus Metyr and head back to the throne and interact with it once more to encounter another NPC invader named Swordhand of Night Jolan, defeat her and you will have to face Count Ymir, Mother of Fingers. This is when Count Ymir borrows the powers of Metyr to fight you. Defeat her and you will be granted the High Priest Set that comes with the High Priest Hat, High Priest Robe, High Priest Gloves, and High Priest Undergarments, as well as Ymir's Bell Bearing and the Maternal Staff. Once Ymir is defeated, you can go outside to the graveyard to obtain the Cherishing Fingers sorcery which you can pick up in front of a gravestone.
links: Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers

eastern-nameless-mausoleum.title: Eastern Nameless Mausoleum
walk: The Eastern Nameless Mausoleum is a location found in the depths section of the Scadu Altus region. To reach this, you need to use the coffin that's located under the main plaza section of the Shadow Keep. When you reach the bridge section of the main plaza (the area where you encounter the Shadow Militia enemies), check the east side of the bridge to find a ladder that you can climb down to the underground area of the Shadow Keep's main plaza. (The ladder is next to a body that you can loot that has a Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot item.)

After climbing down, you'll see a waterfall next to it, go through the waterfall to find a room that has another ladder. Climb down the ladder and you'll find a small storeroom that contains an item, the Domain of Dragons Painting. Approach the wall on the right and hit it to reveal an illusory wall. Beyond is a pathway leading to a sewage area where you'll find a coffin that you can interact with. Resting in the coffin will trigger a short cutscene and you'll be teleported to the depths section of Scadu Altus, specifically by the Castle Watering Hole site of grace See Shadow of the Erdtree Map.

From the site of grace, head southeast where you'll pass the Ruins of Unte. Follow the winding river to the south until you reach the Recluses River Downstream Site of Grace See Shadow of the Erdtree Map. From there, just to the southeast, take the tombstone platforms down and use them to safely reach the bottom. Be sure to take the platforms to the north on the way down, as taking the southward path will take you to the bottom of the waterfall, rather than above it. Next, go north toward a smaller waterfall, and when close to it, turn east and on through a mess of slimes in a narrow canyon, until you reach the end where you'll find the mausoleum.

By the entrance, there is a Summoning Pool or effigy for players to use for co-op. There is also a Stake of Marika that you can use to respawn by the entrance of the mausoleum in case you die. As mentioned, the location is where you'll fight against a mini boss, so make preparations before you pass through the mist. For guides and strategies on how to defeat the boss, please visit the Rakshasa boss page. Defeating this mini boss rewards the player with the following items:
Rakshasa Set
Rakshasa's Great Katana
links: See Shadow of the Erdtree Map

darklight-catacombs.title: Darklight Catacombs
walk: ER Shadow of the Erdtree Darklight Catacombs Video Walkthorugh
ER Shadow of the Erdtree Jore Elder Inquisitor Video Walkthorugh

The Darklight Catacombs is located south of the Scadu Altus region, directly south of the Eastern Nameless Mausoleum. To get there, go to the Recluses' River Downstream Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map, then go traverse the cliffs going south. As you get to the bottom, keep going south. By going in this direction, you will stumble upon the door leading to the Darklight Catacombs. Open the door to gain access inside the catacombs.

Once you are inside the Darklight Catacombs, follow the path leading to a lift. After arriving at the bottom, you can activate the Darklight Catacombs Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map. After activating the Site of Grace, head north to pick up x1 Grave Glovewort [5]. A lionhead Imp will jump on you as you approach the item, so take caution. Once you have picked up the Grave Glovewort, go to the eastern hall right before picking up the loot. Grab x1 Yellow Fulgurbloom right as you head down the path. Turn left, and you'll find another path going down, with x1 Yellow Fulgurbloom in the middle of the stairs.

You will arrive on a ledge area with two Fanged Imps. Defeat the enemies, then drop down the ledge or walk down the ramp. Immediately on the west of where you dropped is a passageway leading to a lever that will turn on the lights when pulled. Go back to where you dropped, then head southeast, passing through the archway. As you turn the corner to the archway, a bigmouth Imp will attack you.

In the room overlooking the lit area, you can drop from the railings onto a ledge, then drop from the broken section of the ledge to a room with a chest containing the Viridian Amber Medallion +3. Afterwards, drop down to a bridge. The room on the south connecting to the bridge contains x1 Grave Glovewort [1] on the east side, and x2 Yellow Fulgurbloom right by the western wall. After clearing the area, follow the path going north leading to another lift. Use the lift to go down.

Follow the path north, going through the ramp on the right side to progress. A Fanged Imp will be waiting for you at the bottom of the ramp. Keep heading north, and you'll find x1 Yellow Fulgurbloom along with a bigmouth Imp opposite of it. After dealing with the imp, go back a few steps and you'll see a ladder going up. Climb the ladder, then turn right through the tight passageway, dropping to a room with a lever. Pull the lever, and you will activate the lights in another area. By the lever, you can drop down safely into a staircase below containing x4 Thin Beast Bones. Follow the path going up the stairs.

Once you have arrived at the top of the second set of stairs, look down by the opening, then drop down to the ledge. Follow the ledge going west, then climb up the ladder in the corner. In front of you, you can pick up x1 Shadow Realm Rune [5] from a corpse, and you will encounter an Inquisitor. You can safely drop to the room below with a body that has x1 Ghost Glovewort [2]. A Fanged Imp will attack you from behind after dropping. You can exit through the archway to the east. You'll be back in the area where you climbed up a ladder to the lever room.

You'll find a broken section of the railings. Drop down to the ledge bellow it, and you'll find a hallway with an Inquisitor on the southeastern corner. In this hallway, you can obtain the Death Knight Set from a dead body by the ledge on the north. South of the hallway, you can find an opening with a ladder going down. Climb down the ladder then head east through the archway. On your left, you'll find x1 Ghost Glovewort [9]. On your right, a Inquisitor will be attacking you. Defeat the Inquisitor, then drop down the ledge.

After dropping down, you can pick up x1 Yellow Fulgurbloom just where you dropped. Go east, then go through the archway going down, leading you to another lift. After arriving at the bottom of the lift, keep heading east. You will encounter a giant Bigmouth Imp which shoots fireballs towards you. Run through it, then turn left to head north. There will be a section here that has a pillar that can serve as a safe spot for you. As you are in the safe spot, a Fanged Imp will approach you. After dealing with the Fanged Imp, sprint to the area where it came from, then pull the lever in the room. Afterwards, kill the giant Bigmouth Imp, then defeat the Fanged Imp that spawns after it.

NOTE: Do not kill the Giant Bigmouth Imp before pulling the lever, or else the Great Ghost Glovewort that it drops will be stuck in the air. If you do kill it and then pull the level, return after respawning at a Stake and you can kill it again to get its item.

Go back to where you dropped, and you can pick up x2 Yellow Fulgurbloom and x1 Ghost Glovewort [8]. Afterwards, head to the pathway that the giant Bigmouth imp was blocking, then enter the room to loot a chest containing x1 Bigmouth Imp Ashes. Head up the ladder on the eastern wall, then keep heading east through the hall. You will encounter a Fanged Imp at the end of the hallway. You can safely drop, then head north. In the northernmost wall, you can pick up x1 Grave Glovewort [4] from a dead body. Head back south going down the ramps, and you'll find another lift which leads you to a boss fog.

Once you head inside the boss fog, you will encounter Jori, Elder Inquisitor. For a more detailed guide on how to defeat Jori, Elder Inquisitor, you can visit this page. After defeating Jori, Elder Inquisitor, you will obtain the Barbed Staff-Spear and the Forsaken Graveyard Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map will be unlocked.

NOTE: The Abyssal Woods can be accessed after defeating the boss of the Darklight Catacombs. After you have defeated Jori, you can follow the path going south to get to the Abyssal Woods region. You can't use your mount in the area, so you will get kicked off of your mount as you approach the region. Keep going south, and you can activate the Woodland Trail Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map. To unlock the map for the Abyssal Woods region, you can keep following the path going south, and you will come across a glowing column with an item. Pick it up to get the Map: Abyss. Nearby, you can activate the Abandoned Church Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map.
links: See Shadow of the Erdtree Map

northern-nameless-mausoleum.title: Northern Nameless Mausoleum
walk: Just like any other mausoleum in the Shadow of the Erdtree DLC, the location is an arena for a mini-boss encounter against the Red Bear. By the entrance, there is a Summoning Pool or effigy for players to use for co-op. There is also a Stake of Marika that you can use to respawn by the entrance of the mausoleum in case you die. As mentioned, the location is where you'll fight against a mini-boss, so make preparations before you pass through the mist. For guides and strategies on how to defeat the boss, please visit the Red Bear page.
Defeating this mini-boss rewards the player with the following items:
Iron Rivet Set
Red Bear's Claw

rivermouth-cave.title: Rivermouth Cave
walk: ER Shadow of the Erdtree Rivermouth Cave Video Walkthrough

As you enter Rivermouth Cave, you will immediately discover the Rivermouth Cave Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map. If you go to the cavern going east, you will encounter 4 wolves in an area. In the northeast side of the room, you can pillage a body for x2 Hefty Beast Bone.

As you head deeper, the path will fork. The path on the right will have two hostile wolves along with a dead body that you can loot for x3 Sliver of Meat. This leads to a dead-end, so return to the path and follow the other path. This path will lead you to an area with an upper level and three wolves.

If you climb up the opening on the east side of the area, you will find a body containing loot. When you get closer to loot the body, the ground will collapse, making you fall. You can then loot the body to pick up a Shadow Realm Rune [1]. The path going northwest will be a dead-end, so go down the path east. As you are traversing the eastern path, you can gather x1 Sanguine Amaryllis along the way.

The path will lead you to an area full of Bloodfiends. If you want to go back up, go to the path on your right, and you will encounter a Bloodfiend. After disposing of the enemy, follow the path west going up, in which you will encounter two wolves. Keep following the path, encountering two more wolves along with a dead body that you can loot for x1 Sacred Bloody Flesh. Keep following the path, which is going north, and you will be back in the area before you fell.

If you wish to continue, you can clear the area by sneaking up on the ogres and backstabbing them. They are also easy to deal with, as you can kill them in around two hits. If you aggro them all at the same time, you can fight one of them at a time by dragging the enemies away from the area. After clearing them, you can gather a few Sanguine Amaryllis around the edges of the blood pool. On the altar, you can pick up x3 Sacred Bloody Flesh. In the northern corner of the area, near the ramp where you came from, you can pick up x6 Sanguine Amaryllis. There will be a boss fog nearby.

When you enter the boss room, you will be facing the Chief Bloodfiend. It is a more aggressive version of the Bloodfiends that you encountered earlier. It can jump towards you from afar, while also using its club more effectively than the ones you encountered earlier. For a more in-depth guide on how to defeat the Chief Bloodfiend, you can go refer to this page. Once you have defeated the Chief Bloodfiend, it will drop x1 Bloodfiend Hexer's Ashes. You can find the exit on the southeastern side of the room.

scorpion-river-catacombs.title: Scorpion River Catacombs
walk: Scorpion River Catacombs Full Video Walkthrough

First you must reach Rauh Base, which is found by take the path north of Moorth Ruins in Scadu Altus- explore east until you find a small pond and go through the ravine, then follow the cave to a swamp, past some gravebirds, and you'll emerge in Rauh Base. From here, go west to Temple Town Ruins, and from there you must follow the way north and west, past pests and scorpions. The exact location is shown on the Elden Ring Map here.

From the Site of Grace, head straight through the catacombs. In the first room, an Imp enemy will ambush you. Afterward, head left down a short set of stairs towards a large hallway, and turn left into a small room. Inside, you'll find a corpse holding Rejuvenating Boluses and two Imps guarding it. Take them out.

Exit the small room and quickly cross the bridge (there is a basilisk statue that causes constant Death Blight build up while in its line of sight) in the middle of the large hallway until you find another set of stairs going down. Follow the path until you reach another large room with two Imp enemies inside.

Eliminate them and head down the stairs of the large room. Just below the stairs is a corpse holding a Grave Glovewort (3). Proceed through the tunnel entrance on the same level to find another room with an Imp guarding a plant on the left that gives you Yellow Fulgurbloom. At the other end of the room is another tunnel, but before proceeding, loot the corpse beside the tunnel to get x5 Redflesh Mushroom.

Head down the tunnel and go straight through the tight path, turning right towards another short set of stairs going down. Do not immediately exit the tunnel after turning right. There's a large spike trap that launches from above. Wait for the spike to go down, then immediately run to the right to a small space that keeps you safe from the spike trap. From here, you can either run to the right to get out of the spike area or go to the corpse on the other side that has the Ghost Glovewort and then run to safety after looting it.

Once you're out of the spike trap area, turn left and drop down to another level, but be careful, as there are three Basilisks waiting to attack you. After killing the Basilisks, head through the tunnel on this level to find another corpse on the left, giving you the Shadow Realm Rune (4). Exit the tunnel, and just to the left, you'll see another Yellow Fulgurbloom.

To the right, you'll find a ladder going up. Head up the ladder and take out an Imp enemy on the edge of the tunnel enjoying the view of the next room. Drop down into the room and loot the corpse on the right for another Ghost Glovewort (5).

Then, head to the left side of the room and up a short set of stairs. Turn left to find yourself back at the spike trap area. Cross the spike trap area again, but instead of dropping down to the Basilisk area, turn right. This leads to an open hallway with Messmer Soldiers inside. Before proceeding toward the Messmer Soldiers, run to a safe space on the right as the first half of the hallway is another spike trap. Once you cross the hallway, take out the two Messmer Soldiers and then the Black Knight with its back turned. After clearing the hallway, loot the corpse on the right near where you fought the Messmer Soldiers to get a Smithing Stone (5). In the middle of the hallway, where the Black Knight stood, loot the altar to receive the Black Knight Captain Huw.

Afterward, head back to the safe area of the second spike trap and climb the ladder going up. Once you reach the top, wait for the spike trap to go down. Before it goes back up, hop on top of it to reach a secret platform above. Loot the corpse there to get the Ghost Glovewort [6]. Hop on the spike trap again to go back to the level above the ladder.

Cross the bridge to the right, and before heading straight through the other tunnel, turn left and cross the ledge. Hop on the spike trap that goes down on the left to reach another secret platform and loot a corpse for the Imp Head (Lion).

Return to the ledge, but before going back, turn left first to the tunnel here and enter the small room at the end. Kill two Imps guarding a corpse that gives you the Knight's Lightning Spear. Afterward, head back through the tunnel. Before exiting to the ledge area, turn left and go up the stairs to a small area with two Imps. Loot the corpse on the left to get x6 Yellow Fulgurbloom.

Once done looting, drop down near the corpse to find yourself back at the crossing point of the ledge where you crossed the bridge earlier. Go through the tunnel now and take the elevator down.Once you reach the bottom, head straight through the catacomb tunnels until you reach an intersection. Turn right and wait a few seconds for a shadow fireball trap to cross. When the shadow fireball passes and goes back, tail it down a set of stairs. There's climbable rubble up ahead, but first, check if the shadow fireball has crossed. If it has, climb up the rubble and turn right to the first path.

Follow the path until you reach a giant Imp guarding a short set of stairs. Loot the corpse to the right for a Grave Glovewort (4) before taking out the giant Imp. Head down the stairs after defeating the giant Imp and you'll find yourself in another large room. Head straight and loot the corpse and plant for a Yellow Fulgurbloom and Ghost Glovewort. Then, go down the ladder to the right of the plant and corpse. Once you reach the bottom, handle the 3 basilisks- who bill be facing away from you, and then loot the corpse to the left for a Great Ghost Glovewort.

Head back up the ladder and turn left through another tunnel, and head up the stairs. At the top, peek first because there are two Shadow Fireballs that will cross. Wait for them to pass above you and then run across the bridge. You can stop in the middle of the bridge and drop down to the left onto a small walkway. Watch out for the imp here, and then get a Yellow Fulgurbloom plant at the end of the walkway.

At the other end of this place, where you dropped down, is a ladder going up. Climb up to find a small room with some Imps and a chest containing the Ancient Dragon Knight's Cookbook (2). Afterward, from the ladder, turn left through a tight tunnel that leads to the second level of a previous area. Loot the corpse on the right for Rejuvenating Boluses.

Turn left towards another tunnel with a Yellow Fulgurbloom plant on the right. To the left of the tunnel is a drop-down path back to where the Shadow Fireball trap of the bridge you dropped down from earlier was. Cross the bridge completely and turn right at the end. There's another elevator here that goes down. At the bottom, walk straight to find a yellow mist that leads to the Death Knight boss battle. This boss drops the Death Knight's Longhaft Axe and Cerulean Amber Medallion +3.

taylew-s-ruined-forge.title: Taylew's Ruined Forge
walk: Taylew's Ruined Forge Full Walkthrough Video

Taylew's Ruined Forge is one of the latest optional dungeons in Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree. Just like the other optional dungeons, it is crawling with interesting items to collect. Starting from the entrance of Taylew's Ruined Forge where the Site of Grace is located. Players can progress in the dungeon by heading through the inner section of it. However, if you haven't found the dungeon yet, click the link here so the interactive map will be able to guide you and find the location of the dungeon.

To proceed, head to the next area by heading through the nearest tunnel. You will eventually see a balcony where you can see stored lava underneath the ruins. Near your location, there's a dead body and upon looting it, receive a Shadow Realm Rune (3). Follow the hallway and eventually, you will come across a ladder and use it to reach the lower part of the area. Follow the hallway and you will eventually come across debris and broken stone floorings that should be able to cross by jumping. You will also notice that this dungeon is part of Scadu Altus.

To proceed, follow the hallway and find a Golem Smith. Note that this enemy is resilient to physical attacks and has a lot of health. However, it is rather slow so plan your attacks and stance and break the said golem until it dies. After beating the Golem Smith, get the nearest loot which is the Smithscript Axe. Continue progressing in the dungeon by exiting back from where you came from and this time, access the lower parts by jumping into the broken part of the hallway.

Follow the hallway and you will eventually reach a long stone pillar that extends to the lava area underneath you and also extends to the upper part of the area. But first, access the adjacent area from where you are. You will come across another lava slime. Defeat and behind it, there is loot near the broken statue which contains the Smithscript Greathammer. Proceed by heading back to the stone pillar and this time head to the upper area by accessing the upper part of the stone pillar.

You will eventually notice that there are two platforms that you can jump off to. Access the one on the left and you will come across two Golem Smith enemies. This encounter will be challenging as both so proceed with caution. One thing to note is, that there's a red stone located at the back of these golems and these are the weak spots of these entities.

After defeating both of the golems, head to the nearest balcony where a dead body lies. Loot the body and get an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone. Head back to the area where you fought the two Golem Smith, loot another dead body, and receive x5 Smithing Stone [4].

To proceed, head back to the stone pillar and use it to get across to the adjacent platform. There are three directions that you can head from here. However, we suggest heading to the lower area by jumping from the platform you are in right now.

You are in the correct area if you landed in Lava Slimes. Follow the hallway and there's a nearby dead body that you can loot. It contains a x3 Smithing Stone [8]. Proceed by heading to the other hallway near the location where a ladder that you can access. Use the ladder to proceed.

After the ladder, you will be greeted with Lava Slimes. Take them out and notice that there's another area or platform where you can jump off too. However, a Lava Slime and another Golem Smith are waiting on the other side.

Take these enemies out and there is another dead body which you can loot. Loot it and get a x1 Somber Smithing Stone [3]. Head to the other hallway near the ladder and find yourself on another balcony. There's a nearby lever that you can interact with. Pull the lever and notice that the stone pillar will change its position so you can access the other side of the area.

To proceed, notice that there's another chained ironed platform that you can jump off to be able to return and access the pillar. But before heading to the stone pillar, notice that there's another hallway near which leads to a dead end.

There's another dead body that you can loot which contains x1 Somber Smithing Stone [8]. Head back to the previous hallway and this time, head to the other hallway which leads to a room filled with Golem Smiths and Lava Slimes. You are in the right area if you notice the Elite Golem Smith that has some kind of burning ember on its head.

Deal with this enemy first and try to lure it from the pack. Be careful though as it can throw lavas at you by using the said ember. After dealing with all the enemies around this area, notice that there is debris that you can use to reach the upper area. Once you reach the upper area, notice that there's an important item to loot.

Loot the said item and receive an x1 Smithscript Shield. We are about to reach the end of this dungeon and proceed by heading back to the Stone Pillar and you will notice there's another area that you can reach on the left while climbing the stone pillar.
Reach the said area and notice that there's a ladder that you can take to proceed. Do so and you will find an altar near your location.

Interact with this Altar and you will receive the following, x1 Taylew the Golem Smith and x1 Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone. This is the end of the dungeon and access the teleporter so you can exit the dungeon.

southern-nameless-mausoleum.title: Southern Nameless Mausoleum
walk: The Southern Nameless Mausoleum is located within the Cerulean Coast region, the southern section of the map. The location is an arena where you can fight against a mini-boss, the Dancer of Ranah. As indicated in the image below, head to the location that's marked in the Cerulean Coast, which is towards the edge of a cliff and near a withered tree. From there, check the left to find a narrow path (below the tree) that leads to a hole that you can drop to enter a cave.

When you reach the bottom, face the compass towards the west and go straight until you exit the cave. You can ride your mount here and avoid fighting the Giant Crab inside the cave. As you exit, you should find yourself on the small island if you open the map. As soon as you reach the surface on the little island, go on top of the rock on the entrance and there's a reusable item "Perfumed Oil of Ranah" held by a corpse. Make a right towards the shore, then up the hill on the left where you'll find a field of blue glowing flowers and the mausoleum. By the entrance, there is a Summoning Pool or effigy for players to use for co-op. There is also a Stake of Marika that you can use to respawn by the entrance of the mausoleum in case you die. As mentioned, the location is where you'll fight against a mini-boss, so make preparations before you pass through the mist. For guides and strategies on how to defeat the boss, please visit the Dancer of Ranah page or view the video guide above.
Defeating this mini-boss rewards the player with the following items:
Dancer's Set
Dancing Blade of Ranah

finger-ruins-of-rhia.title: Finger Ruins of Rhia
walk: Meet Count Ymir at the Cathedral of Manus Metyr and speak to him, he will give you the Ruins Map and the Hole-Laden Necklace. Follow his instructions with the map and head to Finger Ruin of Rhia.

Fast travel to the Finger Ruins of Rhia Site of Grace and make your way down, be careful of the Fingercreepers and Lamprey there. Once you reach the bell, interact with it and you will be granted the Crimson Seed Talisman +1.
Return to the Cathedral of Manus Metyr and speak with Count Ymir again and he will grant you the Ruins Map (2nd) and Beloved Stardust. It is time to head to Finger Ruins of Dheo for the next bell.
notes: You can get to the Southern Shore from the Gravesite Plain following the Ellac River downstream. Cross the Ellac Greatbridge, then head down the slope to the right and stick to the left wall until you reach Ellac River Cave. From here, you can follow the river downstream to reach Cerulean Coast.

The plateau on top of the large ramp leading into the Ruins has a Remembrance Duplication Coffin that can be used to duplicate Remembrances in the same manner as a Walking Mausoleum. Elden Ring Map Link

finger-weaver-s-hovel.title: Finger-Weaver's Hovel
walk: The Finger-Weaver's Hovel See Elden Ring Map is located at the Cerulean Coast, southwest of the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion. You can get to the Cerulean Coast from the Pillar Path Cross Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map directly south of Castle Ensis. Head north of the Site of Grace, wherein you will follow the cliff until you see a part of it that you can jump on. Make your way to the bottom using the rocks, then head south to a cave opening leading to the Ellac River Cave Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map. Keep heading south until you get to the waterfalls, then carefully jump across the rock formations. Head south, and you can activate the Ellac River Downstream Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map. From here until you see glowing blue flowers around the area, which means that you are in the Cerulean Coast. You will then have to traverse through cliffs and rock formations to cross to a graveyard area. Keep heading straight, passing through the naturally formed archway, and you'll end up in the Cerulean Coast.

Finger-Weaver's Hovel can be found northwest of the Finger Ruins of Rhia Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map. You can head down the naturally forming ramp down from there and head west until you find a dilapidated shack with a Spirit NPC sitting in the middle of the shack. You can pick up the Finger-Weaver's Cookbook [1] on the southeastern corner of the hovel. There are bears located nearby the Finger-Weaver's Hovel, so be prepared to face them in combat as you are exploring.
links: See it in the Elden Ring Map

lamenter-s-gaol.title: Lamenter's Gaol
walk: ER Shadow of the Erdtree Lamenter's Gaol Video Walkthrough

The entrance to Lamenter's Gaol is just southeast of the Gravesite Plain site of grace on the map, and directly east of the Artist's Shack. Head northwest behind the huge dead dragon at the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion site of grace. Keep going above the Cerulean Coast and you'll eventually find the entrance to Lamenter's Gaol. Look for fences and metal cages outside the cave entrance. At the Lamenter's Gaol Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map, keep following the path going southeast until you arrive near a locked gate. Before the locked gate, there will be an opening on the left side of the wall. Go through the path on your left, then keep following the path.

You'll find two rooms with an open gate on the right side as you are traversing the path. The first room will only contain a Putrid Corpse. In the second room, you will encounter two Putrid Corpses. After dealing with the enemies in this room, open the chest to receive x1 Gaol Upper Level Key, which will be used to open the locked gate that you encountered earlier. Return to the path then keep following it until you cross a bridge. Enter the room across the bridge, in which you will encounter a Living Jar along with a Putrid Corpse. The room will be filled with numerous cages. On the northern side of the room, you'll find another room with three cages. On a dead body by the middle cage, you can pick up x1 Prattling Pate Lamentation.

albinauric-s-shack.title: Albinauric's Shack
walk: To get to the Albinauric's Shack, you must first defeat Commander Gaius to gain access to the area behind the Shadow Keep. You can get to Commander Gaius by first going to the Church District section of the Shadow Keep. Progress through the Shadow Keep from that side to get to the Storehouse, Back Section, and then eventually the Storehouse, Loft section, where you need to traverse through the beams above the Specimen Storehouse. Progressing through the Storehouse, Loft section will lead you to the lift going to the Shadow Keep, Back Gate Site of Grace [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Elden Ring Map]]]. Once you are at the Shadow Keep, Back Gate, you can walk through the archway going outside to fight Commander Gaius. You can view this page to read a comprehensive guide on how to defeat Commander Gaius. After defeating Commander Gaius, the Scaduview Site of Grace [See Elden Ring Map] will be unlocked, and you are free to explore the area behind the Shadow Keep.

From the Scaduview Site of Grace, head through the archway on the north. Keep following the path north until you see a broken-down house on the west of the path. Approach it, and you will be at the Albinauric's Shack.
An Albinauric Wolfback Archer will be stationed in the Albinauric Shack. Once you have defeated the Albinauric Wolfback Archer, you can loot it to receive Gaius's Greaves.
Head inside the shack to obtain the only item there, a Sharpshot Talisman.
links: See it in the Elden Ring Map
